milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate into the building to visually locate the chest. max_distance=4 ensures the player must walk from spawn (~6.08 blocks away) to within 4 blocks of the chest, which requires entering the building through the doorway. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the chest. Validated via sandbox that spawn distance (≈6.08) exceeds max_distance (4), so this is NOT pre-satisfied.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch trapdoor causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory so this cannot be pre-satisfied. Birch trapdoors break instantly by hand and always drop themselves.
